description.en:
Adds 13 new cow breeds with texture variation to Realistic Livestock RM.
Dairy: Red Holstein, Ayrshire, Jersey, Guernsey, Kerry, Shorthorn Milkers. Beef: Red Angus, Charolais, Shorthorn, Irish Moiled, British Blue, Belted Galloway, Simmental.
Also adds custom male/calf models and per-breed horns to the base breeds (incl. Hereford, Angus, Highland).
Requires Realistic Livestock - Ritter version (FS25_RealisticLivestockRM).
description.de:
Fuegt 13 neue Rinderrassen mit Texturvariationen zu Realistic Livestock RM hinzu.
Milch: Red Holstein, Ayrshire, Jersey, Guernsey, Kerry, Shorthorn Milkers. Fleisch: Red Angus, Charolais, Shorthorn, Irish Moiled, British Blue, Belted Galloway, Simmental.
Fuegt ausserdem eigene Bullen-/Kalb-Modelle und rassenspezifische Hoerner zu den Basisrassen hinzu (inkl. Hereford, Angus, Highland).
Benoetigt Realistic Livestock - Ritter version (FS25_RealisticLivestockRM).
